title: Performance audit 1: evaluating latency, throughput, and stability under Baseline Load loads.
objective: Verify system response time metrics stay within threshold limits under Baseline Load.
preconditions: Load injection node configured with virtual concurrent users.
steps: Establish target virtual user connections for Baseline Load.
Inject constant load at step level 1.
Measure latency, P95/P99 times, RPS, and error percentages.
expected: Response times remain stable. P95 latency is < 500ms, and error rate is 0%.
